packageRules.description: A release line (lts/*) only takes patch updates, so that a line keeps the minor version it was released with. The branch of an update is named after its base branch.
The pull requests of a release line are labelled as such, instead of with the branch:main label of the shared preset.

customManagers.description: Pins of the dependencies in cloud-core-local-dev/dependencies.mk: the release tag of a GitHub repository, named by the renovate comment above the variable
